snapshot.text: Public system hit by funding gaps, medicine shortages and staff leaving, made worse by the end of US health aid. A new national health strategy, a planned national health insurance and absorbing NGO-funded health workers are the government's response.

priorities.title: National health strategy
priorities.text: A new national health strategy to drive sector reforms.

priorities.title: National health insurance
priorities.text: A national health insurance scheme was set to launch in June 2026.

priorities.title: Absorbing donor-funded staff
priorities.text: The government is taking NGO-funded health workers onto the state payroll and targets 32,000 new health workers.
